Our story

It started with a backyard grill

Back in 2019, Rafa and Téo fired up the grill every Saturday for their friends. The joke was always the same: "this beats every burger in town." One day they decided to take it seriously.

They traded the backyard grill for a professional charcoal grill in East Austin, learned to bake brioche by trial and error, and nailed the beef blend after about 40 attempts — the whole crew gained a few pounds along the way.

The essentials haven't changed since: beef ground fresh, buns baked the same day, a real charcoal fire and sauces made in our kitchen, never out of a jug. We'd rather spend on ingredients than on decor.

Rafa & Téo — founders and hostages of their own grill

Quick answers

Before you call

If your question isn't here, shoot us a text — we'll answer while the charcoal heats up.

Text Us
How long does delivery take?

35 to 50 minutes for most of East Austin and nearby neighborhoods. On Fridays and Saturdays after 8 PM it can take up to 70 minutes — we'll text you a real ETA before we confirm your order.

What payment methods do you accept?

All major credit and debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay and cash — in store or at the door with our driver. On DoorDash, you pay right in the app.

How much is delivery?

We deliver within 5 miles of the restaurant. Up to 2 miles the fee is $2.99; from 2 to 5 miles, $4.99. Orders over $50 in East Austin get free delivery.

Do you have a vegetarian option?

We do: the House Veggie, a chickpea and beet patty grilled away from the beef. You can also order any burger without bacon and with herb aioli. No fully vegan option yet — we're working on it.

Do I need a reservation?

We don't take reservations — it's first come, first served. For groups of more than 8, send us a text and we'll set up a spot for you.

How does the live music work?

Every Friday starting at 8 PM, free entry and no cover charge. The weekly lineup goes up on Instagram every Wednesday.
